findings.comment: Site Data Table uses separate rows for Existing Impervious Cover and Impervious Cover Removed rather than separate columns for existing conditions and proposed conditions. Columns labeled s.f., acres, and % do not distinguish data source. SDT must reorganize to show existing conditions in separate column(s) from proposed conditions.

Site Data Table does not provide a total column showing combined existing plus proposed impervious cover values. A single row labeled 'Total Impervious Cover' shows 55,502 sf (59%) but does not clearly indicate this is a combined total or total proposed condition. Add explicit total column(s) showing combined values.

Number of residential units proposed (39 units: 16 two-bedroom, 23 three-bedroom) is not explicitly shown in the Site Data Table. Unit count is shown in a separate Block 17 Site Area Calculation table and the Building Data Table but not in the main SDT. Add 'Number of Units' row to SDT showing total units and breakdown by type.

Units per acre — both permitted and proposed — are not shown in the Site Data Table. Proposed density is 39 units ÷ 2.162 acres = 18.03 units per acre, but permitted density and both values are not displayed in SDT. Add 'Units per Acre' rows showing both permitted and proposed densities.

Building Data Table does not show land use per building per applicable LDC section. The table lists building type (4-plex, 5-plex, 6-plex) and global use designation (Multi-Family Residential) but does not identify land use classification per LDC § 25-2-3, § 25-2-4, or § 25-2-491 for each individual building. Add land use designation column to BDT for each building.

Building Data Table does not show building height per building in both stories and feet. Building Height Table shows heights in feet and MSL (e.g., 33'-4.75" to 36'-1") and height allowed (40'), but building story count is shown only as a global note ('Maximum Number of Building Stories = 3') rather than per building. Reorganize table to show building height in both stories and feet for each building.

Building Data Table does not show finished floor elevation (FFE) per building. FFE values are labeled on the Addressing Plan (Sheet 29) as text annotations (e.g., 'FFE = 687.50', 'FFE = 685.50') but are not included in the tabular Building Data Table on Sheet 9. Add FFE column to Building Data Table showing FFE for each building.

Building Data Table does not include totals for all numeric values (GFA, building coverage, building height) across all buildings. Tables show individual building data for Buildings 1-8 but lack total rows summing Gross Floor Area (total 83,986 sf), Building Coverage (total 32,296 sf), or building heights. Add total rows at bottom of Building Data Table for GFA, coverage, and height summations.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table and Building Data Table on Sheet 9
findings.comment: Building Data Table coverage values do not match SDT building coverage values. Site Data Table shows Proposed Building Coverage as 32,298 sf (34%), while sum of individual building coverage in Building Data Table equals 32,296 sf — a 2 sq ft discrepancy. All 8 buildings are included but values are inconsistent. Verify actual building coverage areas and reconcile between SDT and BDT.

SDT values are inconsistent with survey data. Site Data Table shows Site Area as 94,192 sf (2.162 acres), but survey records cited in project facts show: 2019 deed/survey as 2.158 acres, Travis County Appraisal District (TCAD) as 2.1970 acres, and City of Austin GIS parcel as 2.111 acres (91,944 sf). Reconcile site area with survey of record and explain any differences.

applicableAreas: Site Data Table and Building Data Table on Sheet 9
findings.comment: Building coverage values are inconsistent across tables in plan set. Site Data Table shows Proposed Building Coverage as 32,298 sf, but sum of individual building footprints from Building Data Table is 32,296 sf. This 2 sq ft discrepancy suggests calculation or rounding error. Recalculate and ensure consistency.

Gross site area is inconsistent across documents. Site Data Table shows 94,192 sf (2.162 acres), but Consolidated Site Plan Application states 2.16 acres, 2019 deed/survey states 2.158 acres, Travis County TCAD records state 2.1970 acres (95,701 sf), and City of Austin GIS parcel shows 2.111 acres (91,944 sf). Reconcile gross site area across all tables (SDT, Q1/Q2 if applicable, cover sheet, engineer report).

Gross site area has not been reconciled with Travis County Appraisal District (TCAD) records. Site Data Table shows 2.162 acres (94,192 sf), but TCAD records show 2.1970 acres (95,701 sf) — a discrepancy of approximately 1,509 sq ft or 1.5% difference. Add note to SDT reconciling site area with TCAD records and explaining any difference.

Square footage per unit type is not shown in SDT or Building Data Table. Building Data Table shows 16 two-bedroom units and 23 three-bedroom units distributed across 8 buildings with total GFA of 83,986 sf, but does not calculate or display average or total square footage per unit type. Add calculation showing GFA per unit type (two-bedroom and three-bedroom separately).

Site area available per unit is not shown in SDT. With 39 units on 94,192 sf (2.162 acres), site provides approximately 2,415 sf per unit, but this value is not explicitly calculated or displayed in the Site Data Table. Add 'Site Area Per Unit' row to SDT showing site area available per unit.
